description: This file is a header for the 'SecurityAgent' class within the WPEFramework plugin namespace. It defines the SecurityAgent class, which implements interfaces for authentication, plugin functionality, Web API, and JSON-RPC. The class manages security tokens, access control lists, and interacts with configuration and directory monitoring components. It includes internal nested classes for token dispatching, configuration management, payload handling, and directory callbacks.

classes.name: SecurityAgent
classes.description: Main class implementing security-related plugin functionality, including token management and access control.

classes.name: TokenDispatcher
classes.description: Handles IPC communication and token dispatching, binds to parent authentication interface.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: JSON configuration holder for ACL, connector, and DAC strings.

classes.name: Payload
classes.description: Represents payload data with a token type enumeration.

classes.name: DirectoryCallback
classes.description: Monitors specified directories for changes and loads ACL files.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with a shell service.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitializes the plugin, cleaning up resources.

methods.name: CreateToken
methods.description: Creates a security token based on input data.

methods.name: Officer
methods.description: Returns the security interface associated with a token.

methods.name: Process
methods.description: Processes a Web request and generates a response.
